story: Papa ki death ke baad maine 8 July ko Amrit Life Insurance mein Rs 5 lakh ka death claim file kiya tha. 4 mahine ho gaye, abhi tak settle nahi hua. 3 November ko main khud unke branch office gaya, wahan bole 'documents verify ho rahe hain, wait karo'. Koi likhit jawab nahi diya. Ghar ka kharcha chalana mushkil ho raha hai.
